A '''Super Cow''' is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[cow]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], a Super Cow is guaranteed to spawn except if it is assigned by [[Spria]]. Otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000.{{Source needed}} Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s.

Using a [[meat tenderiser]] on it will complete the [[Beating Your Meat]] achievement.

==Trivia==
* When asked to create an origin for the super cow on the spot, [[Mod Osborne]] jokingly stated that it was created from a normal [[cow]] eating some leaves of [[Brassica Prime]].{{CiteVideo|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JvXAB5r9OZA&t=643|title = RuneScape Developer Q&A - ft. Mod Osborne|accessdate=5 January 2022|author=Jagex|site=YouTube|date=28 July 2015|timestamp=10:43}}
* The Super Cow has a unique name and lacks the common prefixes and suffixes of other elite monsters.
